summary: Iteration 201 testing complete. Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly. Tested drag-to-resize workspace, Bot Store management (browse, install, config, toggle, uninstall), Channel Templates (5 templates), and Webhooks (5 templates + URL/curl generation).

minor.issue: Channels created from templates don't appear in user's my_channels list due to members format inconsistency (template uses array ['user_id'], main system expects objects [{user_id: ...}])

action_items: Optional: Fix channel template members format to use object array like main channel system for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: PortalWorkspace.jsx: DragHandle component correctly implements drag-to-resize with mouse and touch support. Side panel width shows pixel count when custom-dragged (e.g., '500px'), otherwise shows preset name (narrow/wide/half).

BotStoreModal.jsx: Full bot lifecycle management - catalog browsing with category filters, install to channel, installed list with active indicators, config panel with power toggle and editable fields, uninstall.

ChannelToolsModal.jsx: Two tabs - Channel Templates (5 templates: Project, Sprint, Incident, Standup, General) and Webhooks (5 templates: GitHub, Jira, CI/CD, Slack, Monitoring). Webhook creation shows URL, events, setup instructions, and curl command.
Backend routes properly implement: PUT /api/lumi/bots/toggle/{id}, PUT /api/lumi/bots/configure/{id}, POST /api/lumi/templates/channels/create, POST /api/lumi/automation/webhook-templates/create
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features from iteration 201 are working.
